entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling about an order. I... I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number?
It's Sarah Gable, order number 774-29B. It's for the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes.

Okay, Sarah, I see the order here. Received 62 days ago. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

It's the fit. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I saved up for these. But no matter what I do, they just hurt. I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, but every ride just ends with terrible blisters on my heels. I really can't use them.
I see. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I'm looking at our policy now for these cycling shoes.
I hope you can help. I was so excited for them, and now they're just sitting in a box. With money being tight, I was really counting on getting that refund. I just feel so bad about it.

I understand completely, Sarah. And no need to feel bad, we want you to be happy with your gear. Looking here, your purchase falls unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. So, yes, we can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! Thank you so much, Alex. I was so worried. That's such a relief.

Of course. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file for you now. Just package the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once we receive them, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That is perfect. You've been a huge help. Thank you again!
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Have a great day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
